In the case of nitrogen, all oxidation states from +1 to +4 tend to disproportionate in acid solution.
There is considerable increase in covalent radius from N to P but from As to Bi only a small increase in covalent radius is observed.

solution.text:
(i) This is due to the inert pair effect in the heavier p-block elements.

(ii) 3HNO2→HNO3+ H2O + 2NO

(iii) This is due to the presence of completely filled d and l or f orbitals in heavier elements.

Covalent radius l pm; N = 70, P = 110, As = 120, Bi = 150.
